sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG
themes: Indonesia's 270M-plus population and rising middle class keep staple volumes and pricing power structurally insulated from US consumer cycles.

Modern trade and digital grocery penetration are still low, giving listed FMCG distributors a long runway for share gains and margin expansion.
sectors.ai: Indonesia's FMCG is decoupling from the US tape: +0.45% ID versus -1.00% US, with breadth in small caps (NASI +24.79%, INTD +13.82%, WAPO +12.07%) confirming domestic demand, not imported sentiment, is the driver. Rotate into ID consumer names with real volume and pricing power; avoid chasing the parabolic NASI print. Use US weakness as an entry window, not a warning, while the signal stays NORMAL.
